findings.reason: the node would either land an edit the closing arm calls out of scope or skip a step the body requires, and no reading of the section settles which.
findings.text: §16 states unconditionally that "The dispatch also records the reviewed run's id on the review's pointer" (an edit to `recovery_review_dispatch.py`, a declared write path), while the done-when says that where the cause is the snapshot's age "the node lands no product change, records the measurement, and the section closes on it" — the two clauses disagree on whether that edit is made, so a node cannot satisfy both and the section's closure verdict differs between them

findings.reason: a node dispatched to §16 can run neither the reproduction nor the snapshot-age arm without a named surviving input, and would otherwise close the section on a narrative rather than a measurement.
findings.text: §16's measure begins "replay the recorded pointer of `r-20261024T210847645911-review-of-the-pane-shows-every-state-change-91b43f760035`", but that run completed at 2026-10-24T21:28:15Z and no live pointer for it remains (the live pointer directory holds 51 entries, none matching), so the artifact the node is told to replay must be recovered from somewhere the section does not name

findings.reason: the plan's own first instruction rests on two artifacts a later reader cannot open, which is the exact defect the evidence rule exists to prevent.
findings.text: §16's evidence inputs are a deleted live pointer and the obligations snapshot "the hook read", but the snapshot store is keyed by session id and overwritten in place (one file per session, newest wins), so the snapshot from 2026-10-24 21:18Z is not retained either; the section names no durable copy of either input

rubric_items.anchors_resolve: pass — `recovery_review_dispatch._review_subject`, `recovery_review_delivery._resolved_reviewed_run_id`, `ticker.PANE_STATES`, `ticker.CARRIED_PANE_WORDS`, `ticker.stream_carries`, `watch_unit.release_seat_when_misplaced` and `watch_log_path` all resolve at the reviewed revision, and the cited run id resolves in the durable run store.
rubric_items.done_when: a finding — §16's done-when asks the node to replay "the recorded pointer" of a run whose live pointer no longer exists, so the first step of the measure has no named durable artifact to read.
rubric_items.evidence_paths: a finding — §16's measurement inputs are a live pointer and a per-session obligations snapshot, neither of which the section names a surviving path for.
rubric_items.naming: pass — "seat moved" / `seat-moved` name the mechanism, and neither section carries a plan label, ticket number or changelog prose.
rubric_items.reasoning: a finding — §16's body requires a product change the dispatch pointer write, while its done-when permits closing the section with no product change at all.
rubric_items.single_goal: pass — §16 has one goal (the review is tied to its run), §17 one goal (a seat release reaches the panes); the pointer write in §16 belongs to the same goal rather than a second deliverable.
rubric_items.wiring: pass — §16 and §17 name no depends-on/informs edges that fail to resolve; §17's ordering against §15 ("after §15, which writes ticker.py") matches f-alwh-005's body, and §16 is independent as that followup states.
